data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to open RPSystemBroadcastPickerView for iOS screen recording.
data.what_it_does: It launches the iOS ReplayKit broadcast picker view and provides a method to stop the broadcast extension process. It facilitates screen capture and live streaming integration on iOS devices.
use_when: You need to implement screen capture or live broadcasting on iOS using ReplayKit.
You need to trigger the RPSystemBroadcastPickerView from a Flutter application.
avoid_when: You are targeting Android or web platforms exclusively (iOS only).
You do not want to write native iOS extension code for Broadcast Upload Extensions.
strengths: Solves a specific iOS screen broadcasting requirement.
Provides helper methods for both starting and stopping the broadcast.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of native iOS Broadcast Upload Extension targets.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding a Broadcast Upload Extension target (.appex product) in Xcode and writing native iOS code to handle notification-based stop triggers.
